responsibility: Declares the small external interface of the AutoFDO subsystem implemented in auto-profile.cc: initialization and teardown of sampled-profile state, and the helper that tells other IPA logic whether a cgraph call edge is hot enough under AFDO to justify early inlining. It is the public bridge from generic profiling and inlining code into AutoFDO-specific profile loading and hotness queries.
same_name_distinction: This header is only the public declaration surface for AutoFDO state setup/teardown and the hot-callsite query used by other IPA code. Unlike gcc/auto-profile.cc, it does not implement profile parsing, CFG annotation, or the AutoFDO pass itself.
